groups.rationale: Mila client UI, desktop runner, CI and Susan WNS sources changed; their behaviour is documented in chapters 08, 18, 20 and 22, while the system overview, reference, domain and topology views already name Mila and Susan WNS (ADR-0235, ADR-0236) and gain no domain, host or service.

Chapter 08 Mila client rows now describe sign-in recovery (disconnected, Reconnect, Sign out, account shown), deployment removal, SSH key listing and revocation, machine paging, show, request retry/cancel, image and team choices, Info-tab fields and actions, link messages, Try again recovery, thread unread updates and the browser thread start, and device labels; Marshall source is unchanged.

No protocol source changed; Mila uses only existing Porsche commands (ls --after, show, request retry/cancel, images, team list, ssh-key list/remove, device register --label), so the only chapter change is Mila client behaviour in chapter 08.
Only fleet tunnel membership text in chapters 13 and 20 changed (ADR-0239); this group's behaviour, interfaces and verification are unchanged.
No service source changed; Porsche already accepts every command Mila now sends, and the chapter 08 edits describe only Mila client behaviour.

Chapter 18 documents services.susan.wnsAppIds, whose non-empty value requires the WNS_TENANT_ID, WNS_CLIENT_ID and WNS_CLIENT_SECRET secrets; the Mila source bundle output and Susan WNS machine-test subtests add verification without changing deployment, recovery or operations behaviour.

ADR-0235 and ADR-0236, their index entries, the desktop review and Mila/Susan READMEs are added; security, coverage and topology chapters already describe WNS egress and desktop custody, and no governance script or skill changed.
